result:
All 617 existing tests pass and typecheck is clean. The implementation is complete:

- `src/schemas/issue-import.ts` — new row/batch schemas
- `src/types/issue.ts` — `IssueImportResult`
- `src/types/event.ts` — `issues.imported` event
- `src/types/activity.ts` / `activity-labels.ts` — new audit action
- `src/server/db/schema/issue-imports.ts` + `migrate.ts` — `issue_import_batches` table for replay-by-key persistence
- `src/server/repositories/issue-import-repository.ts` — replay lookup/insert
- `member-repository.ts` — case-insensitive active-member email lookup
- `label-repository.ts` — exact-name label lookup
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` — `importIssues`: same access/archive/permission gates as `createIssue`, quota check against the whole batch, rate-limit spend for the batch, replay short-circuit, sequential numbering continuing the project's sequence, assignee/label resolution, single `issues.imported` emit
- `activity-service.ts`, `search-service.ts`, `usage-service.ts` — subscribed to `issues.imported` so audit/search/usage stay correct without per-issue events; webhooks/notifications are untouched and thus silent for imports, as required.
